thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1: inference-service — sustained error_rate > 4% and 3x latency across prod-us (auto-page to oncall). Pager: Jordan Reyes

Jordan Reyes: I see the page, looking now. Initial hypothesis: kv-cache misses spiking for long-tail prefixes, + a few OOMs on gpu-pool-2. Taking lead.

Maria Chen: I'm on the infra side, joining. Can you confirm which route is most impacted? /v1/generate?

Jordan Reyes: Yes, mostly /v1/generate. Error is 502 from the runtime during attention kernel selection on a subset of requests. Logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] gpu-02 inference runtime: KVCacheMissRatio=0.78, OOMs=2, latency=1.2s
[2026-03-15T14:02:13Z] gpu-06 inference runtime: status=502, stacktrace snippet...
```

Devon Patel: On it — I'll reduce the batch size for the affected pool and toggle fallback routing to low-latency variant (inference-v2:ll) to reduce memory pressure.

Maria Chen: FYI I bumped the eviction threshold on the GPU pool to avoid immediate OOM thrashing. Monitoring memory now.

Jordan Reyes: Proceeding with fallback traffic shift. Command I'm about to run: 
```bash
redwood route update --route /v1/generate --policy weight --variant inference-v2:ll=100 --region prod-us
```

Devon Patel: Running that now.

incident-bot: routing-change: /v1/generate -> inference-v2:ll (100%) in prod-us initiated by Devon Patel

Jordan Reyes: After fallback, error_rate dropped to ~0.5% and p95 latency back to 300ms. Good immediate mitigation.

Priya Singh: Great. What's customer impact? Any active customers hit hard?

Jordan Reyes: Quick check with billing/top-customers shows 2 enterprise tenants saw degraded responses; no data loss. Markus from Customer Success is being pinged to inform affected accounts and track any escalations.

Alex Gomez: Can we keep fallback for a bit while we stabilize? Need to avoid flip-flopping. Suggest a 1hr hold with close monitoring and then slow rollback after fixes.

Maria Chen: +1. Also we've added a temporary concurrency cap on the pool to limit new sessions: 
```yaml
# temp config applied to gpu-pool-2
concurrency_limit: 6
kv_cache_evict_percent: 0.2
```

Jordan Reyes: Action plan: 1) Keep fallback on; 2) investigate kernel selection failure and kv-cache miss pattern; 3) plan post-incident review + remediation items. Assigning owners below.

Priya Singh: I'll coordinate the postmortem. Propose 48-hour window for draft and 5 business days for final. Scheduling a postmortem meeting tomorrow 09:30 PT — I'll create calendar invite. Owner: Jordan (incident lead), SRE: Maria, Runtime eng: Devon, Docs: Alex.

Devon Patel: Root-cause short notes so far: a recent kernel selector change (rollout 2026-03-10) interacts poorly with long sequences causing occasional memory blowouts. Also KV cache hit rate dropped after we rolled a cache-key normalization tweak last week. Both contributed.

Jordan Reyes: For follow-ups/Action items (quick list):
- A1: Revert or patch kernel selector edge-case (owner: Devon) — due in 3 days.
- A2: Add canary for cache-key normalization and add a metric for KVCacheMissRatio at route level (owner: Maria) — due in 5 days.
- A3: Tune paging rules: reduce alert flapping by adding a 3-minute sustained window and require both error_rate and p95 to trigger P1 (owner: Priya) — due in 2 days.
- A4: SLO review: reduce false positives by decoupling short-lived tail latency from SLO evaluation (owner: Alex) — due in 7 days.
- A5: Customer comms follow-up and RCA summary for affected tenants (owner: Priya + CS) — due in 1 day.

Priya Singh: Adding those to tracker now. I'll create GH issues and link to postmortem doc.

Maria Chen: Quick monitoring tweaks I'm pushing: create a new composite alert that fires only when 
- error_rate > 3% for 5m AND
- p95 latency > 1s for 5m OR
- KVCacheMissRatio > 0.5 for 5m
This should cut down noise from transient noise.

Jordan Reyes: Agreed. Also suggest we add a non-pager low-priority alert for KV cache drift so we can observe before it hits P1.

Devon Patel: I'll open the PR for the kernel selector fix and add unit tests covering the long-sequence path. ETA: 48-72h.

Alex Gomez: Oncall handoff plan: I'll take the next shift. Jordan, please hand off the incident state and links to logs + actions.

Jordan Reyes: Handoff summary for Alex: fallback -> inference-v2:ll applied; temp concurrency cap on gpu-pool-2; key logs + traces attached in the incident doc; immediate mitigations achieved stable error_rate ~0.5%. Active action items assigned above. No ongoing customer escalations at the moment.

Alex Gomez: Got it. I'll watch the rolling metrics for the next 3 hours, and coordinate rollback once Devon confirms kernel selector patch or we validate cache stability.

incident-bot: note: postmortem meeting created by Priya Singh — calendar invite sent (tomorrow 09:30 PT).

Priya Singh: Postmortem agenda (short): timeline, customer impact, root cause analysis, action items (A1-A5), owners & deadlines, follow-up check-in in 2 weeks.

Jordan Reyes: One more monitoring improvement suggestion: add a per-route KVCacheMissRatio SLI and baseline it for 7 days so alerts are adaptive per workload. Also add a dashboard tile comparing kernel-selection failures by model variant.

Maria Chen: I'll add dashboard widgets and a Grafana panel for kernel-selection failures.

Devon Patel: After the fix, can we do a gradual rollout with a feature flag and validate with synthetic long-sequence load tests? I'll own the test harness.

Priya Singh: All action items are in the tracker. I'll post the draft postmortem after the meeting and tag everyone for review.

Jordan Reyes: Thanks team. Leaving handoff to Alex. Marking incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will update thread if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

Alex Gomez: Acknowledged — taking over.

incident-bot: incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring (by Jordan Reyes)

(End of thread)
